home.title: Start a new file or open a sample.
home.intro: Word-, Excel- and PowerPoint-compatible editors built around an OOXML-faithful core. Every change — human or AI — flows through the same typed command bus.
home.tagline: OOXML-native editor for Word, Excel and PowerPoint, in the browser.
home.workspaceEmpty: No local sessions yet. Import or create a document through MCP to populate this workspace.
home.noSamples: No sample files yet — drop one into apps/web/public/sample-files/.
home.noSamplesLong: No sample files yet. Drop .docx, .xlsx or .pptx files into apps/web/public/sample-files/ and refresh.
home.footer: OOXML round-trip · typed command bus · headless office-agent CLI for server-side AI workflows.

toolbar.insertFootnoteTooltip: Insert a footnote at the current caret position

toolbar.suggestingDescription: Every insert and delete is recorded as a tracked change you can accept or reject later.

toolbar.rejectAllDescription: Drop every insertion and restore every deletion to the original text.

add-comment.label: Add comment
add-comment.description: Add a comment to a range selector and write the result.

insert-image.label: Insert image
insert-image.description: Insert an inline image at a position selector. Reads image bytes from --image.

insert-bookmark.label: Insert bookmark
insert-bookmark.description: Insert a named bookmark at the current selection (paragraph + flat-text offsets).

delete-bookmark.label: Delete bookmark
delete-bookmark.description: Remove a named bookmark from the document.

insert-chart.label: Insert chart
insert-chart.description: Insert an inline chart at a position selector. Embeds a backing .xlsx workbook so 'Edit Data' works in Word.

insert-spreadsheet.label: Insert spreadsheet
insert-spreadsheet.description: Insert a live OLE-embedded Excel workbook at a position selector. Double-clicking the embed in Word opens the underlying .xlsx in Excel.

insert-table.label: Insert table
insert-table.description: Insert an empty rows × cols table at a position selector.

insert-table-from-xlsx.label: Insert table from xlsx
insert-table-from-xlsx.description: Pick a range from an .xlsx file and insert it as a native Word table.

insert-spreadsheet-from-xlsx.label: Insert spreadsheet (live)
insert-spreadsheet-from-xlsx.description: Pick a range from an .xlsx file and embed the workbook as a live OLE object.

insert-chart-from-xlsx.label: Insert chart from xlsx
insert-chart-from-xlsx.description: Pick a range from an .xlsx file and project it into a chart (first row = series, first column = categories).

insert-hyperlink.label: Insert hyperlink
insert-hyperlink.description: Wrap a flat-text range in a paragraph with a hyperlink.

insert-footnote.label: Insert footnote
insert-footnote.description: Insert a footnote reference at the caret and add an empty footnote body.

bullet-list.label: Bullet list
bullet-list.description: Toggle a bullet list on the current paragraph.

ordered-list.label: Numbered list
ordered-list.description: Toggle a numbered list on the current paragraph.

indent-increase.label: Increase indent
indent-increase.description: Indent the current paragraph by one step (¼ inch).

indent-decrease.label: Decrease indent
indent-decrease.description: Outdent the current paragraph by one step (¼ inch).

section-break-next-page.label: Insert section break (next page)
section-break-next-page.description: Insert a next-page section break after the current paragraph.

section-break-continuous.label: Insert section break (continuous)
section-break-continuous.description: Insert a continuous section break after the current paragraph.

insert-table-3x3.label: Insert table (3 × 3)
insert-table-3x3.description: Insert a 3 × 3 table at the current selection.

insert-table-2x2.label: Insert table (2 × 2)
insert-table-2x2.description: Insert a 2 × 2 table at the current selection.

delete-row.label: Delete table row
delete-row.description: Remove a row from a table. The table must have at least 2 rows.

delete-column.label: Delete table column
delete-column.description: Remove a column from a table. The table must have at least 2 columns.

delete-table.label: Delete table
delete-table.description: Remove a top-level table from the document.

resolve-comment.label: Resolve comment
resolve-comment.description: Mark a comment as resolved (or re-open it).

reply-comment.label: Reply to comment
reply-comment.description: Append a reply to an existing comment.

delete-comment.label: Delete comment
delete-comment.description: Delete a comment and its reply thread.

accept-all-changes.label: Accept all changes
accept-all-changes.description: Accept every pending tracked change in one mutation.

reject-all-changes.label: Reject all changes
reject-all-changes.description: Reject every pending tracked change in one mutation.

insert-page-number.label: Insert page number
insert-page-number.description: Insert a page-number field at a position selector.

insert-section-break.label: Insert section break
insert-section-break.description: Insert a section break (next page / continuous / even / odd) at a position selector.

insert-page-break.label: Insert page break
insert-page-break.description: Insert a hard page break at a position selector.

set-page-setup.label: Set page setup
set-page-setup.description: Update page size / margins / orientation on the section that owns a paragraph (in twips).

set-page-margins.label: Set page margins
set-page-margins.description: Set the top / right / bottom / left / header / footer / gutter margins (in twips) on a section.

set-page-orientation.label: Set page orientation
set-page-orientation.description: Set page orientation (portrait/landscape). Swaps width/height when needed.

set-page-size.label: Set page size
set-page-size.description: Set page width and height (in twips) on a section, by preset (letter/legal/a4/a3/a5) or explicit twips.

page-setup.label: Page setup…
page-setup.description: Open the page setup dialog to configure margins, paper size, and orientation.

toggle-marks.label: Toggle formatting marks
toggle-marks.description: Show or hide non-printing characters (paragraph marks, tabs, spaces).

set-mode-edit.label: Switch to Editing mode
set-mode-edit.description: Direct edits commit to the document.

set-mode-suggest.label: Switch to Suggesting mode
set-mode-suggest.description: Edits land as tracked changes for review.

set-protection.label: Restrict editing
set-protection.description: Toggle Word's Restrict Editing element in word/settings.xml. Pass --enabled false to clear; precomputed password hashes are accepted via --password-hash + --algorithm-name + --salt-value + --spin-count.

set-cell-shading.label: Cell shading
set-cell-shading.description: Set the background fill on a single table cell. Pass --fill null to clear.

set-cell-alignment.label: Cell vertical alignment
set-cell-alignment.description: Set the vertical alignment (top/center/bottom) of a single table cell.

set-row-height.label: Row height
set-row-height.description: Set a table row's height in twips. Pass --height-twips null to clear.

set-column-width.label: Column width
set-column-width.description: Set a table column's width in twips (1440 twips = 1 inch).

merge-cells-horizontal.label: Merge cells (horizontal)
merge-cells-horizontal.description: Merge a contiguous run of cells in a single row into one cell with gridSpan.

set-cell.label: Set cell value
set-cell.description: Set a single cell's literal value (string/number/boolean/null/error).

set-formula.label: Set formula
set-formula.description: Set a single cell's formula (with or without leading '=').

set-format.label: Apply cell format
set-format.description: Apply a format patch to a range (font/fill/border/alignment/numberFormat).

add-sheet.label: Add sheet
add-sheet.description: Append (or insert at --at) a new worksheet.

rename-sheet.label: Rename sheet
rename-sheet.description: Rename a sheet by current name.

delete-sheet.label: Delete sheet
delete-sheet.description: Delete a worksheet by name (the workbook must keep ≥1 visible sheet).

insert-row.label: Insert rows
insert-row.description: Insert N blank rows BEFORE a 1-based row index.

insert-column.label: Insert columns
insert-column.description: Insert N blank columns BEFORE a 1-based column index.

delete-row.label: Delete rows
delete-row.description: Delete N rows starting at a 1-based row index.

delete-column.label: Delete columns
delete-column.description: Delete N columns starting at a 1-based column index.

merge-cells.label: Merge cells
merge-cells.description: Merge an A1 range covering ≥2 cells.

unmerge-cells.label: Unmerge cells
unmerge-cells.description: Unmerge an existing merged range (must match exactly).

set-column-width.label: Set column width
set-column-width.description: Override a column's width in CSS pixels (or pass --reset to clear).

set-row-height.label: Set row height
set-row-height.description: Override a row's height in CSS pixels (or pass --reset to clear).

set-row-visibility.label: Hide / unhide row
set-row-visibility.description: Show or hide a single row (row-header context-menu parity).

set-column-visibility.label: Hide / unhide column
set-column-visibility.description: Show or hide a single column (column-header context-menu parity).

set-sheet-tab-color.label: Tab color
set-sheet-tab-color.description: Paint the sheet-tab strip with a custom color (or clear it).

toggle-filter.label: Toggle auto-filter
toggle-filter.description: Apply or remove an auto-filter on the active sheet.

format-cells.label: Format cells…
format-cells.description: Open the Format Cells dialog (Number tab).

format-cells-alignment.label: Format cells: Alignment
format-cells-alignment.description: Open the Format Cells dialog on the Alignment tab.

format-cells-font.label: Format cells: Font
format-cells-font.description: Open the Format Cells dialog on the Font tab.

format-cells-border.label: Format cells: Border
format-cells-border.description: Open the Format Cells dialog on the Border tab.

format-cells-fill.label: Format cells: Fill
format-cells-fill.description: Open the Format Cells dialog on the Fill tab.

format-cells-protection.label: Format cells: Protection
format-cells-protection.description: Open the Format Cells dialog on the Protection tab.

borders-all.label: Borders: All
borders-all.description: Apply borders to every cell in the selection.

borders-outside.label: Borders: Outside
borders-outside.description: Apply borders only to the perimeter of the selection.

borders-thick-outside.label: Borders: Thick outside
borders-thick-outside.description: Apply a thick border to the perimeter of the selection.

borders-none.label: Borders: Clear
borders-none.description: Remove all borders from the selection.

format-painter.label: Format Painter
format-painter.description: Activate the Format Painter to copy cell formatting.

hide-sheet.label: Hide sheet
hide-sheet.description: Hide the active sheet (preserves data; toggle via the sheet tab menu).

conditional-format.label: Conditional Formatting…
conditional-format.description: Open the Conditional Formatting manager dialog.

conditional-format-clear.label: Clear conditional formatting from this sheet
conditional-format-clear.description: Drop every conditional-formatting rule on the active sheet.

data-validation.label: Data Validation…
data-validation.description: Open the Data Validation dialog for the active selection.

data-validation-clear.label: Clear data validation from this sheet
data-validation-clear.description: Drop every data-validation rule on the active sheet.

name-manager.label: Name Manager…
name-manager.description: Open the Name Manager dialog to inspect and edit defined names.

define-name.label: Define name from selection…
define-name.description: Open the Name Manager scoped to the current selection.

merge.label: Merge cells
merge.description: Merge the current selection into one cell.

unmerge.label: Unmerge cells
unmerge.description: Split previously merged cells in the current selection.

insert-image.label: Insert image
insert-image.description: Pick and insert an image anchored to the active selection.

format-as-table.label: Format as Table…
format-as-table.description: Convert the current selection into a structured table.

insert-chart.label: Insert chart…
insert-chart.description: Open the Insert Chart dialog for the current selection.

insert-pivot-table.label: Insert pivot table…
insert-pivot-table.description: Summarise the current selection by grouping a column and aggregating another.

edit-chart.label: Edit chart…
edit-chart.description: Edit the currently selected chart's data range, type, and title.

add-conditional-format.label: Add conditional format
add-conditional-format.description: Add a conditional formatting rule to a range. Pass --rule as JSON matching the ConditionalFormat schema.

remove-conditional-format.label: Remove conditional format
remove-conditional-format.description: Remove a conditional formatting rule by id.

clear-conditional-formats.label: Clear conditional formats
clear-conditional-formats.description: Drop every conditional formatting rule from a sheet.

add-data-validation.label: Add data validation
add-data-validation.description: Add a data validation rule to a range. Pass --rule as JSON matching the DataValidation schema.

remove-data-validation.label: Remove data validation
remove-data-validation.description: Remove a data validation rule by id.

clear-data-validations.label: Clear data validations
clear-data-validations.description: Drop every data validation rule on a sheet.

add-defined-name.label: Add defined name
add-defined-name.description: Define a workbook- or sheet-scoped name (named range).

update-defined-name.label: Update defined name
update-defined-name.description: Update an existing defined name's reference, scope, or rename it.

add-table.label: Add table
add-table.description: Convert a range into a structured table (with auto-filter and styles).

remove-table.label: Remove table
remove-table.description: Convert a structured table back to a plain range.

remove-chart.label: Remove chart
remove-chart.description: Remove an inserted chart by id.

move-chart.label: Move chart
move-chart.description: Reposition a chart on the sheet.

resize-chart.label: Resize chart
resize-chart.description: Resize a chart on the sheet (in CSS pixels).

update-chart.label: Update chart
update-chart.description: Patch a chart's type, data range, header/category toggles, title, palette, legend/data-label/gridline toggles, or axis titles.

set-auto-filter.label: Set auto-filter
set-auto-filter.description: Apply an auto-filter to a range. Pass --range null to remove.

set-filter-column.label: Filter column
set-filter-column.description: Configure a column filter inside an existing auto-filter. Pass --criterion as JSON.

clear-filter-column.label: Clear column filter
clear-filter-column.description: Clear the filter on a single column.

sort-range.label: Sort range
sort-range.description: Sort the rows inside a range (excluding the header) by a single column.

remove-duplicates.label: Remove duplicates
remove-duplicates.description: Remove duplicate rows from a range based on selected key columns (header row preserved).

set-wrap-text.label: Toggle wrap text
set-wrap-text.description: Toggle wrap-text on a range. Wrapped cells display long content on multiple lines instead of overflowing.

set-sheet-protection.label: Protect sheet
set-sheet-protection.description: Toggle Excel's Protect Sheet element on a worksheet. Pass --enabled false to clear; precomputed password hashes are accepted via --password-hash + --algorithm-name + --salt-value + --spin-count.

set-workbook-protection.label: Protect workbook
set-workbook-protection.description: Toggle Excel's Protect Workbook element. Defaults to lockStructure=1 when no flags are supplied. Pass --enabled false to clear.

set-calc-mode.label: Calculation options
set-calc-mode.description: Set Excel's Formulas → Calculation Options (auto / autoNoTable / manual) and the related calcOnSave / iterate knobs.

set-show-formulas.label: Show formulas
set-show-formulas.description: Toggle the Formulas → Formula Auditing → Show Formulas view mode on a worksheet.

set-page-setup.label: Set page setup
set-page-setup.description: Configure the worksheet's <pageSetup> element (orientation, paper size, scaling, fit-to-pages, page numbering).

set-page-margins.label: Set page margins
set-page-margins.description: Set worksheet page margins via preset (normal | wide | narrow) or individual inch overrides.

set-print-options.label: Set print options
set-print-options.description: Toggle Page Layout → Sheet Options (gridlines, headings, centering on page).

set-print-area.label: Set print area
set-print-area.description: Define the worksheet's _xlnm.Print_Area defined name to a range, or clear it.

set-print-titles.label: Set print titles
set-print-titles.description: Define _xlnm.Print_Titles (rows / columns repeated on each printed page).

set-sheet-view.label: Set sheet view
set-sheet-view.description: Patch the worksheet's <sheetView> element. Toggles view mode, gridlines, headings, ruler, zoom, and right-to-left.

open-zoom-dialog.label: Zoom
open-zoom-dialog.description: Open the Excel-style zoom dialog (View → Zoom).

add-slide.label: Add slide
add-slide.description: Append (or insert at --at) a new slide.

duplicate-slide.label: Duplicate slide
duplicate-slide.description: Duplicate a slide; the copy is inserted directly after the source.

set-slide-size.label: Set slide size
set-slide-size.description: Resize the deck. Pass a preset (widescreen / standard / a4 / letter) or 'custom' with explicit cxEmu / cyEmu.

set-show-options.label: Set show options
set-show-options.description: Configure slideshow playback (mode, loop, narration, animation, timings). Pass --clear to drop existing show options.

set-slide-transition.label: Set slide transition
set-slide-transition.description: Set the entry transition for a slide. Pass --kind none to remove an existing transition.

set-slide-hidden.label: Hide / show slide
set-slide-hidden.description: Toggle a slide's hidden flag. Hidden slides stay in the deck but are skipped during slideshow playback.

format-text.label: Format text run
format-text.description: Apply font / size / bold / italic / underline / color to a text run range.

set-position.label: Set shape position
set-position.description: Set a shape's x/y position (in EMU; 914400 EMU = 1 inch).

set-rotation.label: Set shape rotation
set-rotation.description: Rotate a shape by N degrees clockwise around its centre.

add-text-box.label: Add text box
add-text-box.description: Insert a new text box on a slide.

insert-image.label: Insert image
insert-image.description: Insert an image on a slide.

insert-media.label: Insert media
insert-media.description: Insert a video or audio clip on a slide. Embeds the binary as a media part with a poster image and the appropriate <p:pic> reference.

set-shape-geometry.label: Set shape geometry adjustment
set-shape-geometry.description: Tune a preset shape's geometry parameter (corner radius, arrow head size, etc.) by writing into a:avLst > a:gd.

insert-chart.label: Insert chart
insert-chart.description: Insert a chart on a slide. Embeds a backing .xlsx workbook so 'Edit Data' works in PowerPoint.

insert-spreadsheet.label: Insert spreadsheet
insert-spreadsheet.description: Insert a live OLE-embedded Excel workbook on a slide. Double-clicking the embed opens the underlying .xlsx in Excel.

insert-table.label: Insert table
insert-table.description: Insert a native PowerPoint table on a slide from a 2D grid (e.g. a paste from xlsx).

insert-table-from-xlsx.label: Insert table from xlsx
insert-table-from-xlsx.description: Pick a range from an .xlsx file and insert it as a native PowerPoint table.

insert-spreadsheet-from-xlsx.label: Insert spreadsheet (live)
insert-spreadsheet-from-xlsx.description: Pick a range from an .xlsx file and embed the workbook as a live OLE object on the slide.

insert-chart-from-xlsx.label: Insert chart from xlsx
insert-chart-from-xlsx.description: Pick a range from an .xlsx file and project it into a chart on the slide.

add-shape-animation.label: Add shape animation…
add-shape-animation.description: Open the Animations panel to attach an entrance, emphasis, exit, or motion-path animation to the selected shape.

remove-shape-animation.label: Remove shape animation…
remove-shape-animation.description: Open the Animations panel to remove an animation from this slide's sequence.

reorder-shape-animations.label: Reorder shape animations…
reorder-shape-animations.description: Open the Animations panel to reorder the animation sequence on this slide.

add-rect.label: Insert rectangle
add-rect.description: Insert a rectangle shape on the active slide.

add-ellipse.label: Insert ellipse
add-ellipse.description: Insert an ellipse shape on the active slide.

add-arrow.label: Insert arrow
add-arrow.description: Insert a right-arrow shape on the active slide.

zoom-reset.label: Reset zoom to 100%
zoom-reset.description: Restore the canvas zoom level to 100%.

present-from-current.label: Start presentation from current slide
present-from-current.description: Enter presentation mode at the active slide.

rotate-pages.label: Rotate pages
rotate-pages.description: Rotate one or more pages by 90/180/270°.

delete-pages.label: Delete pages
delete-pages.description: Delete one or more pages from the document.

merge.label: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Merge two or more PDFs in order; writes a new PDF to --out.

split.label: Split PDF
split.description: Split a PDF by page range or every-N-pages; writes one PDF per chunk.

extract-pages.label: Extract pages
extract-pages.description: Extract a page range into a new PDF.

add-watermark.label: Add watermark
add-watermark.description: Stamp a text or image watermark across a page range.

add-page-numbers.label: Add page numbers
add-page-numbers.description: Stamp page numbers across a page range.

set-metadata.label: Set metadata
set-metadata.description: Set / clear metadata fields (title, author, subject, keywords).

add-bookmark.label: Add bookmark
add-bookmark.description: Add a bookmark / outline entry to the document.

fill-form.label: Fill form
fill-form.description: Fill an interactive form from a JSON map of field → value.

flatten-form.label: Flatten form
flatten-form.description: Flatten an interactive form into static PDF content.

reset-form.label: Reset form
reset-form.description: Reset every interactive form field to its default value.

add-text-layer.label: Add OCR text layer
add-text-layer.description: Run OCR over each page and embed an invisible selectable text layer.

next-page.label: Next page
next-page.description: Navigate to the next page in the viewer.

prev-page.label: Previous page
prev-page.description: Navigate to the previous page in the viewer.

fit-width.label: Fit width
fit-width.description: Fit the page width to the viewer.

fit-page.label: Fit page
fit-page.description: Fit a whole page into the viewer.

rotate-cw.label: Rotate view clockwise
rotate-cw.description: Rotate the on-screen view clockwise (does not modify the PDF).

rotate-ccw.label: Rotate view counter-clockwise
rotate-ccw.description: Rotate the on-screen view counter-clockwise (does not modify the PDF).

toggle-dark.label: Toggle dark mode
toggle-dark.description: Cycle the viewer through light, sepia, and dark display modes.

toggle-reflow.label: Toggle reflow
toggle-reflow.description: Toggle reflowed reading mode (single-column text reflow).

rotate-page.label: Rotate current page 90°
rotate-page.description: Rotate the current page by 90° (writes to the document; see also pdf.rotate-pages).

delete-page.label: Delete current page
delete-page.description: Delete the current page from the document (see also pdf.delete-pages).

print.label: Print…
print.description: Open the browser's native print dialog for the PDF.
